seo.title: St. Moritz ski resort guide
seo.description: 155 km of pistes on Corviglia - 42 km blue, 79 km red, 34 km black - served by 24 lifts above the Engadin lakes.

seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to St. Moritz in the Engadin.

h1: St. Moritz ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: St. Moritz sits at 1,845 metres beside its lake in the Engadin, with Corviglia rising behind it: 24 lifts and 35 runs totalling 155 kilometres, split by the operator into 42 km of blue, 79 km of red and 34 km of black. Piz Nair carries a restaurant at 3,057 metres, and across the valley the Muottas Muragl funicular climbs to 2,456 metres for a toboggan run of 4.2 kilometres and 20 turns.
stayOverview: St. Moritz Dorf sits above the lake with the Chantarella funicular to Corviglia; St. Moritz Bad is by the water and cheaper. Celerina lies at the foot of the same mountain on the other side.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Dorf puts you by the funicular, Bad by the lake, Celerina on the quiet side of Corviglia.
rentalCars: St. Moritz is on the Rhaetian Railway and reached by road over the Julier Pass, about three hours from Zurich.
